smell: `O.fromNullishOr(input.accountId)` and `O.fromUndefinedOr(input.accessToken)` convert config optional keys into Options inside the resolver instead of the config schema carrying absence explicitly.
proposedTarget: Make optional config absence schema-native: `accessToken: S.OptionFromOptionalKey(S.String.pipe(S.RedactedFromValue)).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)`; for `accountId`, either make it required (`S.String`) or model it as `OptionFromOptionalKey(...).pipe(withNoneDefault)` and keep the config-error check over Option. In-repo exemplar: `packages/foundation/modeling/ontology/src/Ontology.models.ts:152-160`.

exception.reason: Changing `HubSpotConfigInput.accountId` and `accessToken` to `OptionFromOptionalKey(...).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` changes the exported constructor surface from raw optional values to `Option` values and would require edits in `apps/oip-web/src/contact/ContactSubmission.service.ts` (`HubSpotConfigInput.make({ accountId, accessToken })`). Account id precision and base URL/default absorption were remediated in-package; the Option public-form migration is deferred to a consumer-sweep lane.
exception.boundary: cross-package ripple, deferred to family-close sweep

proposedTarget: Use `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(...).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` on decoded first-party fields, preserving omitted keys at the HTTP JSON boundary through schema encoding. This removes `undefined` from the decoded request/response surface while keeping HubSpot's wire shape. In-repo exemplar: `packages/foundation/modeling/ontology/src/Ontology.models.ts:152-160`.

exception.reason: Changing exported request/response optional fields to `Option` values would require edits in `apps/oip-web/src/contact/ContactSubmission.service.ts` for `HubSpotSubmitFormRequest.make({ context, submittedAt })`, `HubSpotUpsertContactRequest.make({ objectWriteTraceId })`, and downstream response/status access. In-package precision, URL, timestamp, non-empty field, and decode-boundary fixes were applied without changing raw optional constructor call sites.

smell: `HubSpotError` and `HubSpotErrorOptions` store `cause`, `email`, `formGuid`, `status`, and `url` as optional keys, while `fromReason` immediately converts option fields with `O.fromUndefinedOr` before spreading them into the error.
proposedTarget: Make error context fields `S.OptionFromOptionalKey(...).pipe(SchemaUtils.withNoneDefault)` in both `HubSpotErrorOptions` and `HubSpotError`; `fromReason` can then pass through Options directly. In-package contrast: `ResolvedHubSpotConfig.accessToken` is already modeled as `S.Option` (service.ts:274).

exception.reason: Changing `HubSpotError.status` and other exported context fields to `Option` would require `apps/oip-web/src/contact/ContactSubmission.service.ts` to stop reading raw optional `error.status`. It would also change the public `HubSpotError.fromReason(reason, { status: 401 })` options surface, which the wave instructions require preserving. Field annotations, URL precision, and integer HTTP status checks were remediated in-package.
